tasks.name: 추천 인접 영상 버퍼와 플레이어 재사용
tasks.summary: Implemented a three-item recommendation preview buffer with pending-request deduplication, stale-response guards, reusable players and VideoViews, deferred release after view detachment, and page-change reset-to-zero behavior. Added manager and screen VM regression tests; all 109 front tests, typecheck, and Expo export passed. HTTP GET returned 200 from localhost:8081 and :3000. Actual browser/native swipe and buffering behavior could not be verified because no UI-driving tool or device was available.

tasks.name: 추천 컨트롤의 목록 내부 배치와 스와이프 복구
tasks.summary: Moved recommendation controls inside FlatList cards and kept the buffered VideoViews in a non-interactive layer below them. Added render-tree checks for touch-layer placement, video/card layering, fallback posters, and FlatList updates. Typecheck, all 109 front tests, and Expo export passed; localhost:8081 and :3000 returned HTTP 200. Actual touch swipes remain unverified because no UI-driving tool or device was available.
